request_granularity: Every sample side is a fresh source request: unchanged complete bundle load, actual compile, and replay to one exact side with the same compiler reach_work. Special release and rollback requests retain one context across both sides. No counter resets, limit overrides, hidden skips, reduced object/action sets, or production-derived expected values.

comparisons.resolved_joint_targets_and_joint_coordin: exact binary64 including canonical zero/half-turn bits
comparisons.world_velocity_and_angular_velocity: finite values, exact-bit equality and absolute component differences recorded; no unstated acceptance tolerance

scope_limits: Not the whole source_execution release role or a full R01-R12/Q01-Q22 requirement map.
World-derived rate tolerances are not explicit in the adopted corpus/profile; measured comparisons remain pending. The supplementary 2e-12 is preparation-only and is not substituted.
Visible object sets and nonempty source geometry are checked; independent full vertex/region/PBR comparison and destination geometry remain separate gates.
P20 is evaluated from its frozen repaired source; atomic Agent edit authority/sibling preservation belongs to the separate LP02 workflow.
Release record/state transfer and frozen payload positions are checked; no native/browser delivery or continuous-motion certificate is claimed.
Compatibility, hostile probes, all Agent operations, release audit and resulting-main verification remain separate.
